guitar.evidence: Yngwie Malmsteen is one of the most iconic Fender Stratocaster artists, famous for his scalloped-fretboard signature Strats used in his neoclassical shred style.

tone.target: bright Strat neck-pickup neoclassical lead with smooth sustain
tone.profile: bright Strat neck-pickup neoclassical lead with smooth sustain
tone.summary: A clean/slightly boosted signal chain using a Plexi-style amp (UK 50) combined with a bright cabinet (UK Vintage 4x12), enhanced by compression, chorus, and delay for singing legato runs.
corrections: Use Strat-like single coils, not generic humbucker high-gain
Keep it smooth and singing, less crunch
Add slight delay; avoid modern metal voicing

rig.name: Yngwie Malmsteen - Black Star - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain harmonics and eliminate hum.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean/lead tones.

blocks.purpose: Sustain and initial signal lift for singing legato runs.
blocks.gap: None. Boost is ideal for adding controlled sustain without heavy distortion.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the warm, slightly broken-up sound of a Plexi/Strat single coil without heavy crunch.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to emulate the classic 'hot Marshall' breakup tone while avoiding modern metal voicing. A dedicated Strat model would be better but is unavailable.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No wah needed for this specific neoclassical tone.
Emulate the bright, articulate sound of a Plexi/hot Marshall suitable for fast leads.
blocks.gap: None. The UK 50 is the best fit for classic rock lead tones.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British sound and necessary brightness for Strat-style leads.
blocks.gap: None. Standard choice for this genre.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle 'singing' dimension and width to the legato runs.
blocks.gap: Chorus is used for its thickening effect, simulating vibrato/vocal quality needed for singing leads.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required slight delay for enhanced note separation and sustain.
blocks.gap: None. Digital Delay is versatile enough for this application.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle space and depth without muddying the bright lead tone.
blocks.gap: None. Room reverb is generally safest for clear leads.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and tonal clarity by swapping the current IR for a more open, bright single-coil focused model.

proposals.reason: Enhance Strat-like clarity and upper mids for neoclassical leads.
